searchText: oh yeah they aren't compression methods though the gain is probably not that big, considering the main bulk of the message is uncompressible (address, r, s) my test with fse ended up making the tx *bigger* though i probably implemented it wrong one way or another, so i'm asking it here though entropy coders/dictionary coders to an extent will be very good for bytecode compression, as they contain a lot of repetitive data I noticed 2 validators missing their first post GrayGlacier proposal despite hitting all attestations with 0 inclusion distance. Is _not upgrading EL to GrayGlacier_ an explanation for that? From reading the `eth1_data` part of the annotated spec I'm not sure if an EL on a wrong fork (pre GrayGlacier) would lead to this behaviour? First instance: https://beaconcha.in/validator/273524#blocks Second instance: https://beaconcha.in/validator/397425#blocks yes, if they did not upgrade their "eth1 endpoint", then they would begin to fail to propose due to not being able to include the requisite deposits whereas, they can still follow and fully validate th beacon chain and thus attest Makes sense. Interesting to see that the vast majority of stakers seem to have upgraded fine, but those two haven't. Staking pools none the less. These are the slots in question: https://beaconcha.in/block/4147297 https://beaconcha.in/block/4147694 The blocks right after do not appear to include any deposits, so these missed proposals might be just that and unrelated to the fork
